newsitem.title: GERMANY: D.Telekom details loss from Atlas. [CORRECTED 16:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: D.Telekom details loss from Atlas. [CORRECTED 16:20 GMT]

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG said on Friday it made a loss on financial activities of 3.9 billion marks (corrects from 96 million marks) in the first half of 1996, largely resulting from losses of its Atlas joint venture with France Telecom.

In its preliminary sales prospectus for its November share listing Telekom said the loss from financial activities was "attributable primarily to a DM 106 million loss reflecting the company's share of the losses of Atlas Telecommunications S.A. through which the company holds its interest in Global One."
Global One is the telecommunications joint venture between Deutsche Telekom, France Telecom and Sprint Corp.
